snippet.title: SOMBRAS: negative frames - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
SOMBRAS: negative frames is a first person narrative game with a focus on photography and light horror elements. Follow Shiomi, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, as she is spirited away in a dark mirror of her 2000s Japanese town and must confront fragments of her own psyche. 

SOMBRAS: negative frames is the second game of Maboroshi Artworks, the creators of the award-winning game ‘Last Time I Saw You’.

Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4553370/SOMBRAS_negative_frames/

Coming to all platforms on December 3 2026


- - -


Developer: Maboroshi Artworks
Publisher: Entalto Publishing
